summary: Operator site, site map and Firefly unit list read; imagery viewed. Lakeview kept (operator says 'waterfront sites' but every loop is behind the shoreline tree belt; no site placeable within 50 m over open ground). $35 confirmed; booking on the operator's Firefly page with FCFS too, 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimums, 14-night limit; 34 W/E sites (no sewer), rigs to 45 ft; ATB/military discounts written.
